Kforce has a client in Kansas City, MO that is seeking a Financial Software Engineer.

Summary:
The Financial Software Engineer will design, develop, maintain, and optimize database and reporting solutions supporting financial and accounting operations. This role partners with Finance, Accounting, and IT to deliver reliable integrations, reporting, reconciliations, and data-quality solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL expertise with knowledge of financial systems, data governance, and development best practices.

Responsibilities:
 
  Analyze and document requirements for data, workflows, integrations, auditing, and reporting 
  Design, develop, test, and maintain database and reporting solutions 
  Build and support integrations between internal and external systems 
  Ensure data flows include validation, auditing, error handling, monitoring, and reporting 
  Develop solutions that ensure financial data accuracy, consistency, and completeness 
  Follow coding, peer review, source control, testing, and documentation standards 
  Troubleshoot database, reporting, integration, and data-quality issues 
  Partner with financial, business, and technical teams to deliver scalable, auditable solutions 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience 
  3-5 years of financial/accounting reporting and data experience 
  3-5 years of Microsoft SQL Server development with advanced T-SQL skills 
  2-3 years of SSIS and SSRS experience 
  Experience with complex queries, stored procedures, views, functions, database design, and performance tuning 
  Knowledge of ETL, data warehousing, databases, and data processing 
  Strong understanding of accounting and financial data concepts 
  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills 
  CTEs, temporal tables, Power BI, Azure Data Factory (ADF), IAS, and insurance industry experience are pluses
